svg.text: ARCADE / Buttons, joysticks and NES interface
All controls are dry normally-open contacts to GND. No control contact connects to +5 V or +3.3 V.

g.text: JA4 is LED data on sheet 03
JA - front / mating face, as in your screenshot
JA6 feeds R6/R7 (10k NES pull-ups); JA12 remains NC.
JA4 = LED data (sheet 03). JA10 = spare / NC.
Use pin numbers and silkscreen; rear cable view is mirrored.
Separate latch and clock lines for each player, exactly as shown.
Due sends active-low serial bits: A, B, Select, Start, Up, Down, Left, Right.
Repository firmware advances on RISING clock edges; verify core timing.
Data outputs are open-drain: LOW or Hi-Z; R6/R7 provide HIGH.
Use a measured timing budget; interrupt-based Arduino code may not
meet a fast core. Slow the FPGA poll clock or use hardware serialization.
USB service and switch debouncing must never block the NES interface.
Each joystick uses 4 NO contacts and a shared GND common.
Each player has one Start, Select, A and B: 8 pushbuttons total.
Configure all 16 inputs with INPUT_PULLUP; debounce in firmware.
Due Native USB goes to the Pi USB host. Do not use Programming USB
for HID. Use short signal/common pairs for long cabinet harnesses.

svg.text: ARCADE | 2026-10-14 | Wiring documentation - logical connector positions; no PCB fabrication.
